name: portfolio-website
description: Portfolio website built with React, Node.js and TypeScript

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @portfolio/server" "npm run dev -w @portfolio/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @portfolio/server && npm run build -w @portfolio/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/server && npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/client
